summary: Elevate your skills with our Frontend Web and Mobile Development Training. Master React and Flutter to build stunning applications. Enroll today!
lede: Frontend development with React and Flutter focuses on turning interface designs into maintainable web and mobile applications. For frontend and mobile developers, full-stack practitioners and UI implementers, the course covers building reusable components and maintainable state, connecting APIs with clear loading and error handling, and checking features through tests, performance reviews and release workflows.
audienceIntro: Designed for professionals tasked with translating UI/UX designs into reliable, scalable user experiences, this course is ideal for:
audience: Public sector and NGO digital teams
modules: State Management and Forms in Flutter
Collaboration, Git Workflow, and Code Quality
prerequisites: Prior experience with JavaScript and basic understanding of mobile development concepts is recommended. Familiarity with HTML/CSS and version control systems like Git is beneficial.
